Results.ReviewText: Very easy to adjust flame temperature.  Cooks items evenly.  Like the 3 burners vs the 2 or 4 version. Good size cooking area.
Results.Title: Three Burner unit

Results.ReviewText: Have had several Weber grills and great experience with them.  Bought this one as it was smaller and fits our needs now. Put it in storage for movers as we are moving to another state. Noticed a small crack on plastic side shelf. Customer service would not help with this before they received pictures. Even after I explained I did not have easy access to it. We will live with it.
Results.Title: Great grill customer service not so much

ClientResponses.Response: We are really sorry to hear about your experience with the gas leak. We understand this had to be very scary. We will have our team reach out again to follow up with you. Please look for an outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The grill was given to me as a gift with HIGH accolades. It worked well for a number of times prior to July 4th. On this date, when started, after ignition, there was a loud hissing, upon inspection, there was a fire at the regulator underneath. we were able to suppress the fire and inspect the regulator connections with the customary soap and water test. There was a leak at the regulator. A replacement regulator was purchased, installed and tested same as above. There were no more leaks, and the grill has functioned ok since then. I reported the incident. The customer service insisted that the case be directed to the incident review team. It was directed immediately, and I provided all requested pictures. They determined that it was a faulty tank, despite that tank being used prior to and since the incident. I disagree with their assessment.  I am disappointed and absolutely astonished that , at no point, did anyone request that I return the regulator that was removed for inspection.  This is amazing and , I feel, a negligent, irresponsible reply.
Results.Title: Follow up customer service

Results.ReviewText: Doesn’t sear as expected.  Other than that it’s fine.
Results.Title: It performs

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill because my previous grill just flamed out (no pun intended). Bought this Weber because of the Weber reputation and reviews I read.  Have had the grill for about three weeks now and so far it's working as expected.  Burners light easily and grill heats up fast enough.  Food cooks great.  Tonight I cooked salmon and paddock.  I like my food well done and tonight's meal came out perfectly.  The three burners ensure my food gets cooked to my taste.  For smaller items like shrimp, scallops, etc. you'll need a grilling plate for those items.  Easy to clean as well.  Hoping this will last a number of years.
Results.Title: Eating Better Now!

Results.ReviewText: Very functional and grills great.  The only problem I have is moving the grill from one place to another.  There is no good place to grip the grill in order to roll it.  The wheels are a little too small for the weight of this grill and should probably have a bigger set on the other side with brakes to make this a truly great grill.
Results.Title: Mostly happy but could be improved.

Results.ReviewText: I wish it had an enclosed  back, my little friends ( raccoons) like to go after the grease tray.  So I need to remove it if I let it sit out over night.  I bought it at ace hardware, but they didn't have a floor model, so I didn't realize no back until it was delivered.
Results.Title: No back

Results.ReviewText: I hate that it only has 2 wheels. My patio is a little crowded. I have to store it against vinyl siding & of course wheel it away for cooking. It is inconvenient! Also there’s no indentation for the propane to set in. Hate how it wobbles when I move the grill.
Results.Title: Needs 4 wheels for easier access.

Results.ReviewText: We love our Weber. The only problem is that the brats are too far spaced. We didn’t notice this when we bought it. We’ve had to buy a grill top to compensate for the wide spaces.
Results.Title: We finally have our Weber!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are really sorry to hear about what happened to the hose on your grill. Hope no one was injured. Our Care team has escalated this to the appropriate team. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
The propane hose disconnected from the regulator while using it. The grill caught fire and we were lucky to extinguish it without the LP 
tank blowing up. The grill was only used two times before it caught fire. The regulator hose assembly is assembled by Weber at their factory. We receive very poor customer service trying to rectify this issue.
Results.Title: Horrible customer service!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, perfect size. Built strong and holds temperature to make grilling easy.
Results.Title: Just the right size

Results.ReviewText: Good quality materials. Good assembly directions. The folding shelves are nice, but you have to make sure they lock in place. I don't like the open back design. Not a lot of inside storage. The igniters work really well. Satisfied. I just need to get familiar with temperature controls,  etc.
Results.Title: Weber spirit

Results.ReviewText: Other brands rust out, while the Weber lasts and lasts.
Results.Title: Top quality/Top value

Results.ReviewText: Excellent so far, assembly was greatly improved from my last two weber grills.  I just hope the materials stand up this time my last grill frame rusted away in just a few years...  I have been a weber grill owner since 1984.
Results.Title: Great start, I trust the quality I expect is back

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We're sorry to hear you are having issues with the ignition on your new grill. Our Care Team will reach out to assist you in resolving this issue. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill preassembled from one of the big box stores. We’ve only used it a few times as it is at our cabin. Right away, we noticed that the ignition button fails to work most of the time. I have gotten it to function once, so I know it’s hooked up, but most of the time it does nothing. I was also disappointed that the bottom cabinet does not include a back enclosure, which means It’s going to become a home for critters. Frankly, I wish I had just bought a super cheap grill that I know would only last a few years, because this one doesn’t seem like it’s on par with the Weber name.
Results.Title: Middle of the road, probably wouldn’t buy again

Results.ReviewText: Love my new Weber. My last one lasted 31 years.  Weber is the only way to go!!!!!
Results.Title: Love my weber

Results.ReviewText: I have enjoyed using the grill for a month from first buying. Size is great for a townhouse patio and provides more than enough grilling space for 2 retired people and their guests. However, open back should be enclosed as it leaves tank exposed to elements. Also either needs 4 wheels or a handle on the side with no wheels so it can be more easily moved.
Results.Title: Great size and features but could be improved.

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback on the new Spirit E-325 Gas Grill and are sorry to hear about your disappointing experience with its design and features. Your satisfaction is our top priority. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
I have been a very loyal customer for many years with Webber Grills as the last E210 lasted 10 years. I recently purchased the E-325 and have not used it all that much I am a little disappointed in some of the things that appear to be Cost saving for Webbers production of this Grill.#1 Grill needs to have 4 wheels for Mobility,#2 The weight Gage for the propane tank to monitor Gas usage, #3 Closed backside of the Grill for esthetics.
I have also noticed when you use this Grill at Higher temperatures the Handle gets Very Hot. On a last note, you could have kept the features I mentioned and raised the price of the Grill to keep Webber Product above the others, When you start building a product Cheaper Consumers start to look elsewhere.
Results.Title: Webber E-325

Results.ReviewText: Grilling is easy with the even and consistent heat. No hot spots or flareups
Results.Title: Grilling made easy

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill with features I wanted for a reasonable price.
Results.Title: Weber grill for grilling!

Results.ReviewText: Heats fast and cooks better than any grill previously owned.
Results.Title: Spirit E-325
